༄༅/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin chen spungs pa'i ri rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin chen spungs pa'i ri rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ shrī ga ṇa pa ti sap+ta rat+na ku tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde chen gar gyis rol mdzad pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyin byed dmar ba'i phreng ba dang mtshungs 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing*/ /'jigs rung bdud sde'i snying drungs 'byin mdzad rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rmad byung sku/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi bdag la de 'dir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ /sku bri ba dang sgrub pa dang*/ /spogs dang las la sbyar ba dang*/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /de ltar don bzhir gnas pas/ dang po sku gzugs bya ba'i cho ga brjod par bya ste/ rgyu skar rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i dus su tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa'am/ ras dar dmar po la 'og nas 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs ltar bris la/ de'i nyin par sgrub pa'am rgyu skar mchog la mchod pa dang gtor ma phyir bshams te/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dar dang rin po che'i steng du bzhugs la/ bdag nyid 'byung po 'dul byed ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rin chen brgyan/ /dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar te/ /rdo rje thod khrag steng 'og 'dzin/ /de bzhin 'og ma'i g.yas g.yon gyis/ /mda' gzhu rgyab tu 'gengs pa 'o/ /mche gtsigs zhal ni bgrad pa dang*/ /mdog sngo thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /ro dang nyi steng g.yon brkyang zhing*/ g.yas bskum stag gi sham thabs 'dzin/ / 'od zer mthing ga 'bar bar bsgom/ /de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed la/ snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis tshogs bdag spyan drangs la mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs de la gnyis su med par bstims te/ dbang bskur nas rin chen 'byung gnas kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la mchod pas mchod de/ rten 'brel snying po dang nye ba'i snying po la sogs pas me tog 'thor nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de/

gsol ba btab nas rdzas dang mnyam du sba zhing bcang bar bya ba ni sku bri ba'i cho ga'o/ / don gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dpyid zla ra ba'am 'bring po'i tshes brgyad la mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas sam nyams dga' bar gzhi bdag dang rigs drug la gtor ma byin nas/ maṇ+ḍal khru do la sogs ji ltar rigs pa la zlum skor bris pa'i dkyil du re khā drangs te/ zla gam kha sprod kyi tshul du byas pa'i stod kyi zla gam la pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud dang bcas pa bris pa'i steng du sngar gyi sku de bzhugs su gsol/ zla gam mdun ma la 'dab ma brgyad bris pa'i lte ba'i steng du lha bshos mkhar thabs su brtsigs par mar dang glang shas brgyan te/ spos dang zas snas brgyan pa rten gtor du byas pa dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du lha bshos mar gyis brgyan/ sha lhu brgyad dam med na dum bu brgyad/ chang ti brgyad/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sprus pa'i ril bu brgyad rnams gzhug pa'i rtsar/ nya phyis sam/ dngul phor ram/ dung chos su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ltai bar bha dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la re re bzhin/ oṃ āḥbha hūm̐ swā hā/ mu khyud bzhi la rim pa bzhin du nang nas nye snying*/ snying po dang ming gi snying po rnams dang 'bod pa'i sngags rnams gi waṃ dang dkar gsum mngar gsum dri bzang dang sbyar bas bris te spel tsha dang bcas pa bris pa'i snod sbubs te bzhag go /gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med 'byor tshad bsham mo/ /si la dang tsan+dan dmar po'i bdug spos spyan 'dren dus su dbul par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas su rnal 'byor bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po bdag nyid bskyed cing sgom bzlas bya ba ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma dang dbyer med pa la sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor ba byon pa la yan lag bdun pas mchod gsol byas nas/

mchod bya mchod byed kyi ngo bo thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de'i ngang las ri rab chen po'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma dang bgegs kyi gdan gnon zhing*/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang*/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ bar rdo rje drwa ba dang*/ mda'i drwa ba dang*/ phyi ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus kyi yi dwags kyi steng na hūm̐ las bdag nyid 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gcig spyan gsum 'bar ba'i stangs stabs can/ /bgegs tshogs mnan cing skrag par mdzad pa me re'i klong du bskyed pa'i snying kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng na hūm̐ dang mtha' skor du sum+bha nis bskor par bsams la/ snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas steng gi nam mkhar rdo rje 'dzin pa de kho na 'dra ba byon pa la mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstims la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ snying ga'i sngags la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags ci mang du bzlas te rab tu dmigs par bya'o/ /de skad du mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ de lta'i mchog gi sgrub pa nyid/ /ma mo rnams ni sgrub pa'i mchog /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ khro bcas zhal ni bzhad pa la/ /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /yi dwags zhon zhing nyi mar gnas/ /gar ldan sum cu gsum 'jigs mdzad/ /stag gi pags pa'i gos 'dzin cing*/ /rgyan gsum bzang po'i gzugs can de/ /ba dan gsum pa rdo rje dang*/

/tho ba dang ni mtshan mo 'dzin/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag dag na/ /de bzhin mda' dang gzhu nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ bdag nyid bskyed zin nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bstan zin to/ / gnyis pa mdun bskyed bya zhing bzlas pa ni/ de ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i mdun du brag ri chen po'i rtser/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i byi ba sngon po rin chen skyugs pa'i steng na gha dmar skya yongs su gyur pa las/ tshogs kyi bdag po dmar po glang po che'i sna can g.yas g.yon du gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dang ral ba'i thor tshugs rat+na'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dpung rgyan dang do shal 'chang zhing*/ me tog dmar po'i thod dang phreng ba can/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na rim pa bzhin du dgra sta dang*/ mda' dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ral gri dang*/ 'phang mdung dang*/ g.yon drug na gtun shing dang*/ gzhu dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ sha chen gyis bkang ba thod pa dang*/ /phub chung ba dan bsdebs pa ste drug gis rim pa bzhin no/ /de la g.yas kyis rdo rje dang g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gis bkang ba gnyis thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing*/ gzhan rnams brkyang pa'i rnam pa'o/ /stod smad rin chen sna tshogs dang ba ti khra bo'i sham thabs nor bu'i phreng bas bcings shing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas byi ba'i mgo mnan nas g.yas ba'i rting ba g.yon gyi phyin pa la gtad de gar mdzad pa'i 'od zer dmar po 'khrug pa'i bdag gi bsgrub bya 'gugs shing nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na gha dmar skya la yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bskor ba can bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phro ba dang mnyam du/ oṃ gha gha sid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha sa dha me pra swa dha me hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brjod ma thag tu 'od kyis bskul te tshangs pa'i gnas nas snga ma lta bu'i tshogs bdag nam mkhar byon pa la mchod de/

dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun gyi bris sku mdun bskyed kyi ngo bo bskyed ma thag pa de la bstim/ slar yang me tog dmar po la sogs pa dang bdug spos sil mas mchod de dgyes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥgha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ oṃ ba ga trai ka daṃṣ+ṭha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā ste snying po 'bum dang*/ oṃ bhūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti swāhā/ ming gi snying po 'bum rnams sum sbril lam/ thog mar oṃ āḥgha hūm̐ bon bzlas pas rtags byung ba dang dngos grub blang bar bya'o/ /gzhan gsum po ma bzlas kyang 'gal ba med/ /'bod pa dang bsnyen sngags kyis nges par 'grub ces bla ma'i man ngag las brgyud do/ /de ltar gang 'thad bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i nor bu dang dbang po la sogs pa'i gzi brjid/ lha dang klu dang mi'i 'byor pa thams cad dang*/ gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa'i bsgrub bya thams cad bkug nas bdag gi khang pa'i nang dang rkang pa'i drung du bdag la chags pas lus dmar zhing gcer bur lhags nas/ de'i rnam par shes pa bdag gi snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis sngags bzlas te/ thun 'jog khar mchod pas mchod de bdag gi 'dod pa'i don tshogs bdag gis bsgrubs par bsams la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung rdo rje yi/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan/ /bgegs kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa la sogs pas bstod de/ lha yi nga rgyal gyis langs la sems can gyi don du bsngo ba byas la sgyu ma lta bur gnas par bya'o/ / de ltar bsgom zhing nyin re bzhin tshogs bdag gi mdun du shug pa'am 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam gzhan gyis brtsigs la me spar ro/ /'og nas 'byung ba ltar lha bskyed pa la dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i bag phye dang khur ba mang du byas pas sbyin sreg zla ba phyed nas gcig gi bar du bya zhing*/ tshogs bdag gis log 'dren brgyad khri bzhi stong bskul nas/

de dag gis bsgrub bya dang nor dang 'bru+u la sogs pa dbang du byas te bdag la phul bar bsam zhing*/ 'jig rten thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ /de ltar rgyas pa'i 'og tu gtor ma yang rtsa sngags kyi phul la mnyes par bsam zhing*/ khyad par du tho rangs kyi dus su bzlas brjod brtson pas sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ rten gtor bcas pa de gsol bar bsams la snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ / thun mtshams su snod gtsang mar ci 'byor pa bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs bdag mdun du bsams la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis phul la/ rgyal ba'i bzhed pa 'grub pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal chu bor gnas pa yi/ /skye bo yun du bskyab pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin gsal ba'i zhal/ /ma rig sgrib pa spangs pa'i sku/ /'jig rten 'dir ni don mdzad pa'i/ /tshogs bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha rnams khyod la mchod par byed/ /tshogs bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /me tog phreng ba rat+na'i dbyibs/ /la du+u la phug yid 'ong zas/ /tsan+dan ga pur du ru ka/ /li la sogs pa'i spos mchog dang*/ / mar me rol mo la sogs pa/ /mchod pa'i bye brag bsam mi khyab/ / bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod/ /bdag la dngos grub rgya chen stsol/ /oṃ gha gha sid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha ye che ge pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥdzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas bstod par bya'o/ /de ltarabasgrub pas sgo rdung ba dang*/ thog 'tsheg pa dang*/ 'od 'byung ba dang*/ lcags la sogs pa'i tshong dpon byed pa dang*/ glang zhon pa dang*/ yongs phung rtse zhing kha zas sbyin pa la sogs 'byung ngo*/ /'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang blo'i cho 'phrul du thag bcad pa rang graul du bzhag pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i rtags de dag byung ba dang bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i phyir/ gnas de nyid du maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi ser por byugs la 'dab brgyad bkod pa'i phyi rim du gru bzhi rgya dang dpangs nyis 'gyur byas pa'i mthar mu ran gru bzhi la rin chen 'bar ba brgyad dang*/

lte ba dang 'dab ma me tog dmar po'am ser po'i tshom bu bkod de/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis gru bzhir brtsigs la/ rang nyid stan gos ser po byas te sgeg pa dang bcas pas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis lho nas byang phyogs su blta ste/ dga' zhi spro bas 'dug la bdag gi rnal 'byor dang mdun bskyed la mchod de/ me lha ser po las 'dod rgyu 'byung bar bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rat+na sna tshogs/ shing tog sna tshogs/ phyugs nor gyi spu/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ 'bru sna tshogs/ mar dang kha zas sna tshogs/ tsan+dan dkar po/ me tog ser po rnams g.yas su bsham shing*/ g.yon du mchod pa lnga/ gtor ma gnyis bshams pa'i gcig gzhi bdag la sbyin/ de nas bsreg rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi mthar 'byor ba puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod nas bstod de/ brgya stong la sogs pa 'bul zhing gsol ba btab nas/ mar dgang blugs gsum dang gtor ma 'bul/ gsol ba btab pas mnyes te bdag gi gnas der rat+na'i char phab par bsams la/ bzod par gsol te/ gshegs su gsol ba ni dgos pa ma yin te bris sku la bstim par byas nas/ thal ba ri rtse'am mi phyugs kyis 'thung ba'i chur 'dor bas 'byor pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyun du byed na bsreg rdzas ril bur byas la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de ltar skye bos dben par zla phyed du bsgrubs pas rmi lam sngar smos pa ltar dang*/ me tog dmar po 'thu ba dang*/ /nyi ma shar dang ri rtser phyin/ /rgyal po bdag gi dbang du 'du/ skye bo mang pos bskor zhing dga' ba dang*/ dngos su yul dpon dang ya rabs dbang du 'du ba dang*/ sngar pas nyams dga' ba dang*/ skye bo byams pa la sogs pa 'byung ste grub rtags so/ /sgrub pa'i cho ga brjod zin to// // don gsum pa de ltar sgrub byas kyang rtags ma byung na spogs pa'i cho ga la gnyis/

dang po sngags bzlog ste bzla/ des kyang ma grub na phyed nas bzlog ste bzla/ des kyang ma 'grub na 'bru dkrugs te/ oṃ gha āḥswā hūm̐ hā/ zhes brgya phrag gcig bzlas pas rtags mi 'byung mi srid do/ /rtags byung nas las la sbyar ro/ /de ltar byas kyang sgrub pa'i rtags med cing thogs ser bab pa dang*/ chu kham pa 'bab pa dang*/ gcan gzan mche ba gtsigs pa dang*/ mi dmar pos rgol ba dang*/ nor 'phrog chom rkun sogs dang snying mi dga' ba sogs zlog rtags byung na sngar ltar sum 'dab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /des kyang ma grub na/ oṃ ba ra ta ka ye swāhā/ nye snying dang*/ oṃ ba ga tre ka daṃṣ+ta bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po dang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti te swā hā/ ming gi snying po 'bum bgrang*/ mnyam du 'bod pa'i sngags ci 'grub bzlas pas rtags byung ba dang dngos grub blang ngo*/ /des kyang ma 'grub na gnad la dbab pa ni/ bris sku'i mdun du thab gru gsum bris pa'i steng du tsher ma gru gsum du brtsigs la/ rang nyid khro bo rdo rje 'dzin par dmigs la/ tshogs bdag sngar bzhin thab tu bskyed la bsreg rdzas ril bur byas pa brgya rtsa brgyad nas/ mar khu brgya rtsa brgyad/ bal lu'i dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad rnams spel la/ sum+bha ni'i mjug tu 'di'i sngags gong ma gnyis btags te sum sbrel gyis phul la/ ḍā ma ru'i sgras tshogs bdag bskul/ des log 'dren rnams bskul/ de rnams kyis rang gi 'dod pa sgrub bar bsam zhing*/ zhag bdun du byas pas sngar bzhin rtags byung nas dngos grub blang ngo*/ /des ma grub na rten gtor bris sku mdun du bshams pa de dag g.yas phyogs su bsham pa'i bar la yol ba dmar po btang la/ rang nyid 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal bas tshogs bdag zhabs kyis mnan bar bsgoms la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mtheb cung mnan la/ bar ma gsum rdo rje gdengs pa'i phyag rgyas gzir zhing*/

gu gul dang sha chen gri khrag rnams kyi dud pas bris sku bla rdo dang bcas pa bdug cing*/ gsum sbrel te bzlas pa'i 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pas gdung bas ma bzod nas 'jig rten gsum gyi tshe dang longs spyod/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus nas rang la dngos grub byin bar bsams la/ sum+bha ni'i mjug tu sngags gsum bzlog nas bgrang ba sbril la/ til nag po la bstims te bris sku la brabs bas tshogs bdag gi zhabs g.yon byi ba'i steng du brdab pas rat+na sna tshogs skyugs nas rang gi gnas khang de khengs par bsam zhing sngags bzlas pa'i gzhan btson du bzung ba dang*/ brdungs pa dang*/ rid pa dang*/ rang la 'dud pa dang*/ nam mkha' las rat+na'i char 'bab pa dang*/ me tog legs po rgyas pa dang*/ gter rnyed pa dang*/ 'bru sna rat+na la longs spyod pa dang*/ ri'i khong gseng nas nor bu 'bul ba dang*/ byi'u 'am mi dmar pos phyag byed pa sogs de ltar bzang rtags rnams spogs pas byung ngam ma spaugs pa'i dus su byung yang rung ste/ sngar gyi sgrub rdzas rnams kyi phud tshogs bdag la mtshon nas rang gis spyod cing*/ nya phyis la sogs 'khor lo can gyi snod du bdud rtsi bzang pos bkang ste/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor thams cad de la bsdus la/ srin lag gis mnyes te yig 'bru rnams 'dres pa de 'thungs pas ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams 'grub cing gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam mo/ /dngos grub blang thabs 'di med na rang gi gnyen 'dun yin yang zas nor mi ster pa dang 'dra bas 'di shin tu gal che'o/ /mchod gtor la brtson par bya'o/ /dkon mchog mchod/ tshogs bdag la mchod/ dbul po la sbyin gtor bya/ de ltar sus bsgrubs shing 'bad pa la longs spyod tshogs bdag nyid dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /'di rgyud 'jam zhing bkra shis te sgrub pa po tshe ring zhing nad gdon gyis mi tshugs so/ /skye ba kun tu longs spyod dang ldan no/

/'di log 'dren brgyad khri bzhi stong gi dpon yin pas bgegs rigs thams cad bdag gi mdun du 'ong mi nus shing bar gcod byed mi nus so/ /sgrub pa gzhan byed pa'i yang sngon du 'di'i bsnyen sgrub thebs na bgegs kyi bar gcod mi 'byung ngo*/ /rgyal po la sogs che gnyan btsun gsum rnams 'dun zhing mchod pas dbang du 'gyur ba dang*/ sngags pa skal pa bzang po de dag gis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ ji skad smras pa'i tshig la dgras kyang ngo mi bzlog par sgrub pa dang*/ snyan grags bsod nams rgyas shing skye ba thams cad du 'byor ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di zab pas gzhan gyis ma tshor bar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /bla ma dam pa'i mgul gyi bum pa'i zhal shes kho na'i gdams pa'o/ /de ni yang gsang bla ma'i zhal shes ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten du rab shel zla ba dang*/ bye ru/ gser rnams la rim pa bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ dam ga bris pa'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la rab gnas sngar bzhin byas te sku dang mnyam du bcangs bas/ 'khu zlog ngan pa dang mi 'grub gtan nas mi srid pas 'di shin tu zab bo/ / des nges par 'grub pa'i sbyar ba bstan zin to// // da ni las la sbyar ba la don lngas bstan te/ bsnyen sgrub dngos grub blang ba gong du rdzogs nas/ dang po gtor ma la brten nas 'byor ba spel zhing dbang du bya ba ni/ bsgrub bya dang nor dang zas la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i gzugs ming spel tshig dang bcas la bā shaṃ ku ru hrīḥzhes pa bris te/ dgug gzhug yang yang byas pa 'dzin gtor gyi 'og tu bcug ste steng du tshogs bdag gong dubaskyed la gtor ma de phul nas/ gang 'dod pa de la gsol ba btab nas sngags ring spe tshig dang bcas pa bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis gtor ma de brabs pas/ tshogs bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus gang 'dod pa de bkug nas dbang du bsdu bar bsams la/

zhag 'dun du tho rangs kyi thun la sogs par byas na gang 'dod pa de 'grub bo/ /grub pa dang gtor ma gsos te gtong rag tu 'bul zhing gzugs dben par sba'o/ /glo bur du dgos pa byung na gtor ma gcig bshams la/ bza' btung la sogs pa gang 'dod pa de'i rnam pa'am gzugs byas la/ de dgug gzhug byas te tshogs bdag bskyed pa la phul nas gsol ba btab la/ gtor ma dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de'i phyogs su btang nas bzlas pa sngar bzhin byas pas de ma thag tu 'grub bo/ /'gro lam lta bur mchod gtor ma 'grub na gong gi bsreg rdzas rnams phyi mar byas la ril bu phyi mar gyis sbrus pa'am sbrang rtsis dril ba bzung la/ nangs par skar ma ma yol dus tshogs bdag mdun du bskyed la/ bdud rtsi'i phyi ma srin lag g.yon pa'i sen mo gang phul la/ gang 'dod gsol ba btab nas snying po brgya rtsa re bzlas pas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas las thams cad 'grub bo/ /yang tho rangs bsgrub bya la dmigs te tshogs bdag gi rkang pa'i drung du drangs bar bsam zhing bzlas pa stong phrag gcig byas pa'i mchil ma gi waṃ dang bsres nas dpral bar thig le byas nas sngar gyi bsgrub bya de la bltas pa tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur zhing*/ thig le mthong ba tsam gyis skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gtor ma gcig gtang rag tu 'bul lo/ / dus thams cad du bzlas sgom dang gtor ma byas na 'du 'bral med par grib ma bzhin du tshogs bdag rjes su 'brang zhing don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma de dag khyi dang bya rog la mi sbyin zhing shin tu gsang ste sgrub bo/ /de nas dngos grub kyi dang po de kha dog dmar por byung na bzang ngo*/ / gnyis pa sbyin sreg gi las sbyor ni/ nor dnga'abru la sogs pa 'dod na sngar bstan pa bzhin bya zhing*/ bsgrub bya dbang du byed na sku gzugs kyi mdun du zla gam dmar po khru gang kha khyer dang mu+u

ran phyir skyed pa la/ dbang la pad+ma/ dgug pa la lcags kyus mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar lcags kyu'i steng dang 'dab ma la tshom bu dmar po dgod/ me tog dmar po dang ldan pa'i shing ngam rgya shug thab kyi tshad du brtsigs pa'i g.yas su yam shing dmar po sor bcu gnyis pa dang*/ mar dang*/ me tog dmar po dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ la du dang*/ la phug dang*/ khur ba dang*/ zas sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ dūrba rnams gur gum gyi chus sbyangs pa/ dmar po ma yin pa rnams rgya skegs kyis bsgyur te bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs shing*/ g.yon du gtor ma dang mchod pa dang spyan gzigs bzang po yang bshams la/ rang nyid stan gos dmar po dang dmar po'i thod chings 'dzin pas pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis chags pa'i bsam pas kha nub bltas te/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis thab dang rdzas rnams la nang mchod kyis gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs shing*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las pad+ma rwa ga'i thab tu byin gyis brlabs te/ smad 'tshong mas me spar la tshogs bdag bskyed de/ oṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs bgegs rgyal tshogs kyi bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes nas kyang*/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /oṃ gha gha la sogs kyis tshangs pa'i gnas nas spyan drangs te bstims la/ dbang bskur te pad+ma'i gdan phul la/ tshogs bdag gi lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur pa'i sbu gu nas dgang blugs kyi ram̐ la phog pas legs bar gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti te e dī byā dī bya bi shud+dha ma hā shrī ha ka bya ba ha na ya sarba pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥs byon zan dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā

hā/ zhes rnam lnga 'gres pas mchod/ de nas nang mchod kyis mchod la bstod nas dngos grub rlangs la/ oṃ āḥgha hūm̐ swā hā/ sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha te ma ma rak+ṣa 'byor pa pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐ḥdzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ brjod cing rdzas rnams re re bzhin phul la brgya stong byas nas/ khyad par du gang 'du ba de mang du 'bul zhing gsol ba btab nas 'bul ba rdzogs pa dang*/ sngags kyi mthar che ge bā shi ku ru hoḥ btags la mar dgang blugs bdun phul la gtor ma btang ste mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba btab pas mnyes nas dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ tshogs bdag bris sku la bstims te las kyi rjes bsdus la/ thab ba yul khams kyi mi phyugs kyis 'thung ba'i chu'am ri rtser bskyal bas dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg go / gsum pa 'khor lo'i las sbyor ni/ rgyal gyi nyin par mthing shog gam gro ga la sogs pa la gser ram snag tsha dri bzang bsres la/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i rtsibs la gha brgyad dang*/ mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po'i ming spel dang bcas pa/ lte bar che ge mo dbang du bsdus shig gam/ oṃ oṃ nor spel cig bri/ rtsibs mchan la sngags ring spel tshig can bris la rab gnas byas la bcangs pas nor 'grub par byed pa lus la bcang ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de bzhin du rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i rtsibs la sngags ring dang rtsibs mchan la ming spel/ mu khyud la rten 'brel/ lte bar che ge'i 'byor ba dbang du sdus zhes bris nas rab gnas byas pa 'khor lo gong ma dang kha sbyar te sbrang rtsis bsdams la zangs kyi gwa'ur bcug ste/ 'byor ba ci yod kyi phud dang*/ nor sna 'bru sna/ zas gos g.yang can gzhan yang der bcug ste tshogs bdag tu bskyed nas mchod pa 'bul zhing bla rdo dang mnyam du 'bral med du bcangs na don thams cad 'grub bo/ / bzhi pa gri lag gi rnal 'byor ni/

'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sngar bzhin bris nas/ rkun chen grir shi ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo la dar sna dang bcas pa btags la/ tho rangs gcer mor phyungs te sngags ring bzlas shing*/ gri lag de las 'od 'phros pas longs spyod bsgrub bya thams cad bsdus par bsam zhing g.yab pas sa rnams g.yo zhing nor rnams 'phar/ srid gsum 'bad med dbang du 'du/ /mis mi mthong bar bya'o/ / lnga pa gter gyi bum pa'i las sbyor ni/ rgyal gyi nyin par rdza'i bum pa so ma lngar/ tsakra sngar bzhin bris la/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga/ snying po lnga/ dar zab la sogs pas bkang la/ dmigs pas gter chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ gcig gi kha rkun chen gyi lag pas bcad la bang mdzod du sba/ bzhi por rdza'i tsakra rtsibs brgyad la sngar gyi tsakra sbyar bas kha bcad la khang pa'i phyogs bzhir sbas la tshogs bdag gi longs spyod kyi gter du bsams la mchod pa dang gtor ma phul te/ longs spyod kyi gter 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gter chen por 'gyur zhing bsam pa thams cad 'grub bo/ /nor bu rin chen rgyal mtshan rtser mchog gsol ba btab las ches lhag pa'i/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub pa gsal bkod dge ba rgya mtsho'i snying po des/ /bdag dang 'gro kun 'byor tshogs rin chen srid bde'i dpung gi 'byor pa dang*/ zhi ba rin chen gling du legs bgrod 'phags pa'i nor gyis 'byor par shog /tshul khrims bang mdzod blo gros nor bu'i 'byung gnas las/ /tshul khrims lus bzang blo gros rgyan phreng 'dzin pa yi/ /tshul khrims 'dod 'byung blo gros lta bu'i mchog 'di brtsams/ /tshul khrims khang bzang blo gros nor gyis 'byor slad yin/ /dpal tshogs bdag gi sgrub pa 'di bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi zhal shes ma lus pa bsgrigs pa'i bdud rtsi yang dag pa'o/ /snyan ngag mkhan kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer bsam yas pas bkod pa'o//

// oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal 'byor rol ba'i chu 'dzin la gnas 'jig rten bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus/ /rgud pa'i gdung ba rnam par bsal mdzad 'dod rgu'i char gyi rgyun 'bab cing*/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mchog gi dpal mnga' phrin las 'brug stong cher sgrog cing*/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi bdag po mngon 'dod re ba rdzogs slad bstod/ /bri dang rab tu gnas bsgrub pa'i/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i 'khor lo ni/ /skal ldan gyi rnal 'byor pas rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i nyi ma la 'di'i cho ga rnams brtsam par bya ste/ de bri ba/ rab gnas sgrub pa'o/ /bri ba rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /steng dang 'og dang bar gyi 'khor lo nyid do/ /thog mar gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo bar ma bri bar bya ste/ 'og nas 'chad pa ltar las kyi rim pa dbye bas/ dkar po la sogs pa'i gzhir tshogs kyi bdag po'i lto bar rim pa dgu bskor ba'i dbus su zhi rgyas dbang drag gi rim pas/ zla ba dkar ba dang*/ nor bu dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ gru gsum brtsegs ma bris pa'i dbus su gha gsum gsum so sor bris te/ dbus de oṃ gcig /g.yas dang g.yon dang gyen du 'khor lo/ bar bha gsum la/ oṃ āḥgha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis 'khor bar bri'o/ /de'ang zhi rgyas dbang dang srung ba rnams la ni yig mgo phyir lta bas gnas shing*/ de las gzhan pa la zlog pa bri'o/ /de nas khor yug dang po la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab re re'i dbus su a re re'i mthar las kyi spel tshig 'khor bar bri'o/ /gnyis pa la/ oṃ gha gha sid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra swa dha ye swā hā/ gsum pa la/ oṃ ba ka ta ye swā hā/ bzhi pa la/ oṃ ba ka trai daṃṣ+ta bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lnga pa la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ga ṇa pa ye swā hā rnams spel tshig dang bcas pa bri'o/ /drug pa la dbyangs yig bcu drug dang*/ bdun pa la gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi dang*/

brgyad pa la rten 'brel snying po rnams spel tshig bcas pa bri'o/ /dgu pa la zhi ba la zla ba/ rgyas pa la nor bu/ dbang la zhags pa/ dgug pa lcags kyu/ bsad pa la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'khor bar bris la/ de kho na ltar sngags kyis spel ba bzlog pa'i rim pas steng 'og gi 'khor lo kha sbyar du bri ba ni bar 'khor bri ba'i man ngag go /steng 'og gi 'khor lo yang khor yug tu drug bskor ba'i lto bar gha la spel tshig bskor ba dang*/ khor yug dang po la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir 'bod pa'i sngags yig 'bru bdun dang*/ shar lhor nye snying dang*/ lho nub tu ming gi snying po dang*/ nub byang du snying po dang*/ byang shar du rtsa sngags rnams spel tshig dang bcas pa'o/ khor yug gsum pa oṃ 'ba' zhig gi mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi par dbyangs/ lnga bar gsal byed/ drug par rten 'brel gyi mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /da ni de ltar dgod bya'i 'khor lo de yang zhi ba'i cho gar bris na zhi bar 'gro zhing gzhan gsum po de bzhin no/ /lha'i nor bu rin po che ras dkar pos dkris te chur btsud na dkar por 'gyur zhing*/ de bzhin ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu la sogs gang gis dkris pa de'i kha dog tu 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo yang gcig nyid bzhir 'gyur ba yin pas/ de la bzhi las/ dang por zhi ba'i cho ga ni/ n+ya gro ta'i 'dab ma la sogs dkar po la/ 'bras kyi khu bas zhi ba'i shing gi smyug gus shar du bltas te sngar brjod pa'i cho gas bris te/ bdag che ge'i nad gdon lce 'bab pa la sogs gang 'dod pa zhi bar bya ba de shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā bris te mdun du bzhag nas/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas 'khor lo de nyid stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las bris pa ltar bskyed de/ ye shes pa bcug nas/ rten 'brel snying pos me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis dang smon lam byas nas/

mar sbrang gis kha sbyar te zlum por dril nas steng 'og gi rim pa ltar skud pa dkar pos dkris te/ ga bur dkar po 'o ma sbrang gsum bsres pas dgang zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen snod du 'bru blugs pa'i steng du bzhag nas/ rang nyid 'byung po 'dul byed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa bya ste/ 'khor lo de nyid rin po che dang pad+ma nyi ma bye ba'i steng du/ tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bcu gnyis par bltas pa'i thugs kar bris pa lta bu'i 'khor lo bsams la ye shes pa bcug nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyis tshogs bdag des bgegs thams cad bskul nas/ bdag gi mi mthun pa'i gnod pa nad gdon thams cad dang dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bar bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar nad gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa bdun bzlas te/ 'khor lo de nyid khug ma dkar por bcug la mchan khung g.yon du bcang zhing*/ skabs su snga dro'i dus su mdun du bzhag ste sngar bzhin sgom bzlas byas pas nad gdon dang rgyal po'i chad pa dang chom rkun dang 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni zhi ba'i cho ga'o/ / rgyas pa la n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i 'dab ma ser po la 'jag rgod ser po'i 'bras khu bas bri ba sogs rgyas par dbang drag kun la tshogs bdag kyang ser po sgyur sngags puṣ+tiṃ des 'gre'o/ / 'gre shes par gyis shig /dbang la gro ga la gur gum/ rgya skyegs/ gi'u waṃ/ pad rag /sin+dhu ra/ mug rnams kyi khus bas bsad mnan rengs pa bskrad pa bya rog gi sgro'i smyu gus bri'o/ /srung dang zlog sngags kyi sngags kyang bsgyur rig pas dpyad dgos so/ /de yang zhi rgyas dbang srung bzhi la ni sngags mgo phyir bstan/ drag po tsam la nang ngo*/ / gzhan bzhi la zhag bdun bdun pa/ drag po la nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bdag gi bar gcod zhi nas dgra bgegs rnams rmugs rengs brlag par 'gyur ro/

/ da ni spogs chog ni/ de ltar las bzhi gang byed kyang rmi lam du tshul ngan pa sna tshogs byung zhing ma grub na sngar gyi 'khor lo bla rdo'i ga'u rnams klad la lan gsum phyin kar bskor nas rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi drung du bzhag la/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sngags dang sgom pas gzir zhing*/ 'khor lo tshogs bdag tu bsams la sgom bzlas drag tu byas pas zhag gsum na 'khu ldog cho 'phrul thams cad zhi nas/ sgrub ba po la dngos grub gdon mi za bar 'byung ngo*/ /de nas 'khor lo si las bdug ste tshogs bdag la bzod gsol bya'o/ /cung zad la de ltar mi bya'o/ /byas na snying thag ring ba yin no/ /las yang dag pa'o/ /shin tu gsang bas dngos grub myur du mi 'byung dbang med pa'i las brjod do/ /yun ring du gzhung bzhin bsgrubs kyang grub rtags med na gzhan gyis bar chad byas pa yin pas de la 'di bsgom dgos so/ /byi ba la sogs pa nas stong par bsgom pa'i ngang las brag ri dang*/ pad nyi byi ba'i steng du gha yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid tshogs bdag tu gyur pa'i snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su gha la/ oṃ āḥgha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor bas bsam pa'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i gnas nas tshogs bdag spyan drangs la mchod/ bdag gi spyi bo nas bdag la thim/ bdag nyid gzi brjid chen po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis yi ge bcu bdun pa dang drug pa'i mthar gang 'dod pa'i spel tshig btags la bzla zhing*/ lus las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i tshe dang dpal 'byor bsdus shing bgegs kyi rigs thams cad gzir bas de rnams kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi 'byor ba dang skye bo thams cad bkug nas bdag la phul bar bsams la/ sngags bzla zhing yang 'od 'phros pas stod gsum dang khyad par 'dzam bu'i gling khab cing skye bo thams cad kyi snying la zhugs pas tshur drangs te rang dbang med par bdag gi rkang pa'i mdun du bkug nas sgrub pa gang 'dod kyi dngos grub gdon mi za bar 'grub ste/

thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba thugs kyi gdams pa'o/ /des rang la 'khu zlog mi 'ong zhing dngos grub shugs las 'byung ngo*/ /yang longs spyod spel ba'i phyir thab kyi cho ga brjod pa ni/ thab khung rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sbyangs par thab yol gyi nang du tshogs bdag gi thugs kar 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sku gzhug cing*/ sgyed po tsa tsi ka'i snying kar longs spyod sgrub pa'i 'khor lor sba'o/ /thab khung du 'bru dang zas sna tshogs pa'i gter sbas te dgug gzhug bya/ bkra shis brjod la bza' btung rgya chen pos zhal bsro bya'o/ /thab yol gyi tshogs bdag zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba byi ba'i steng na bzhugs pa'i zhal du sgyed bu'i lha mo tsang tsi ka dmar mo g.yas tshogs bdag la zas sna tshogs kyis mchod cing g.yon ne'u les nor bu+u skyugs par bsams la/ thum bu kha ma log pas bza' btung g.yas pas tshogs bdag la mchod par 'gyur zhing*/ des thab ka'i longs spyod rgyal po bza' btung gang byed phud tshogs bdag la mchod pa dang*/ gzhan la mi sbyin no/ /de'i 'khor lo ni gro ga la gur gum gyis mu khyud lnga'i lte ba la spel tshig dang*/ dang po la nye snying dang*/ gnyis pa la snying po/ / gsum pa la ming gi snying po/ bzhi pa la rtsa sngags/ lnga pa la 'bod pa'i sngags/ thams cad kyi mthar 'jig rten khams kyi zas thams cad bā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bya ba spel te bri'o/ /thab kyi cho ga'o/ zab po/ de bzhin du bang mdzod kyi cho ga ni/ mi rab bdun du phyug pa la sogs kyi bang sa dang mdzod kyi sa bslong la/ rang gi bang sa dang de'i rtsa dngos su tshogs bdag gi sku 'khor dang bcas pa bcug nas rab tu gnas/ bang ba 'brus bkang zhing phyug po'i nas la sogs pa blug /gzhan yang nor sna tshogs bdag gi spyan gzigs su rab pa de ltar byas la/ rab gnas byas te g.yang can gyi yid btags/

'bru+u la sogs pa'i phud tshogs bdag la mchod na mi zad pa'i mdzod du 'gyur ro/ /mi zad pa'i mdzod kyi go cha'o/ /'di dag ni rang bzo dang yig tshogs spangs nas bla ma'i zhal shes phyag len kho na bkod pa'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i drin gyis legs rtogs nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhal gdams yig chung 'di/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtsho kun gyis thob bya'i phyir/ /gnas skabs 'dod rgu'i bsam don 'grub pa dang*/ /mthar thug sku gsum yid bzhin nor bu'i gling*/ /bdag dang 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /sarba mad+ga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rin chen spungs pa/ -PAGE 424--PAGE 445--PAGE 422-
